description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹財務資訊與數量分析的基本概念，培養學生運用Excel, VBA、R 與Python 等程式工具進行金融數據處理與分析的能力。課程內容包括：金融資訊系統基礎、金融資料庫簡介、程式設計訓練及金融數據分析實務等，透過理論與實作的結合，培養學生具備金融資訊的收集、處理與分析能力。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces the fundamentals of financial information and quantitative analysis, aiming to develop students’ ability to use programming tools such as Excel, VBA, R, and Python for financial data processing and analysis. The course covers basics of financial information systems, introduction to financial databases, programming skills, and practical financial data analysis. Through the integration of theory and hands-on practice, students will cultivate the ability to collect, process, and analyze financial information.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 上課期間，同學可使用電子產品隨堂查詢課程內容的相關資訊，切勿發生聲音影響教室授課環境，彼此間互相尊重。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
All course activities will be conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere among students, with respect and appreciation for each student's personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, including domestic and international educational systems, diverse admission and learning cultures, and gender.
Classroom behavior should always be timely, professional, well-prepared, and polite. Effective learning requires mutual respect and dignity among students, teachers, and other lecturers.
Students should be punctual. Unless you are sick or have an emergency, you should arrive at the classroom and be seated before class begins. If you need to leave early for any reason, please inform me in advance.
All students should respect everyone in the classroom and act reasonably, responsibly, and politely at all times.
Do not talk, read, sleep, or do assignments unrelated to the course during class. Minimize marginal conversations except for group discussions.
You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When presenting, speak loudly to your group or the whole class so that everyone can hear you.
Headphones are not allowed. Make sure to turn off mobile devices such as cell phones and PDAs during class, and put them away and keep them silent.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
This course introduces the essential concepts of financial information and quantitative analysis. It aims to learn how to use the software (Excel) to record, sort and analyze financial information. The topics include: operations of Excel and VBA, introduction and management of financial database.
本課程介紹財務資訊和定量分析的基本概念。 旨在學習如何使用軟體（Excel）記錄、整理和分析財務資訊。 內容包括：Excel和VBA的操作、財務資料庫的介紹和管理。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on integrity. Any student who promises to present unfinished work as their own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in assignments, quizzes, or exams, or who assist others in such acts, will receive a zero grade. Any violations will be reported to the Feng Chia University Student Awards and Punishments Regulations.
If you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or submit all or part of someone else's paper or assignment, it will be considered cheating.
